photos.author: Smallbones
photos.description: Decatur Street in Stuyvesant Heights Historic District Listed by the NRHP on December 4, 1975. The district is roughly bounded by Macon, Tompkins, Decatur, Lewis, Chauncey, and Stuyvesant • Boundary increase (listed November 15, 1996, refnum 96001355): Roughly, Decatur St. from Tompkins to Lewis Aves. in Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn, New York. This is one of the nicest historic districts I've seen, and very large as well.

photos.author: John J. Kelly III
photos.description: Photo of a FreshDirect refrigerated delivery truck featuring a branded sliced citrus design outside of a row of brownstone homes in the Bedford-Stuyvesant neighborhood of Brooklyn, NY. This is part of a fleet of branded delivery trucks which the company uses to deliver fresh food and groceries to its customers. FreshDirect is an online-only e-commerce grocery delivery service serving the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic regions of the United States.
